This repository contains data accompanying the manuscript 

P. Christodoulou, M. Gałka, N. Dogra, R. Lopes, J. Schmitt, and Z. Hadzibabic.
"Observation of first and second sound in a Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless superfluid"
Accepted in Nature in March 2021.

Any additional information is available from the corresponding authors on reasonable request.


CONTENTS
========

1. Figure X folders



1. FIGURE X FOLDERS
===================

These folders contain the source data for data points shown in the corresponding figures in the 
manuscript. There is one folder per figure and each text file within a folder corresponds to one 
of the experimental data sets shown. The columns correspond to the quantities and uncertainty values 
(denoted as d(quantity)) as shown in the corresponding figure in the paper; 
units match those used in the manuscript.

Naming of files: 
   FigXi_------.txt
      X = {1,2,3} and i = {a,b,c,...} indicate the sub figure.
      The remainder of the text-file title provides further distinguishing details.
